senses.gloss:
नृ + -सिंहः, -हरिः
—1 ‘a lion-like man’ a chief among men, an eminent or distinguished man.
—2 Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation; अस्त्राण्यमोघमहिमानि निरूपितानि
 नो पस्पृशुर्नृहरिदासमिवासुराणि Bhāg. 1. 15. 16; cf. नरसिंह.
—3 a particular mode of sexual enjoyment. ˚चतुर्दशी fourteenth day
 of the bright half of Vaiśākha. ˚द्वादशी the twelfth day of the
 light half of Phālguna. ˚पुराणम् N. of an उपपुराण.
